answer_1.quote: LLM-Based Multi-Agent System LLM-MAS enables agents to collaboratively engage in planning, discussing, and decision-making.
answer_1.outputs: natural language communication, action sequences, collaboration requests and responses

answer_2.quote: we propose the Trajectory Efficiency Score (TES) and Incremental Trajectory Efficiency Score (ITES) to assess the collaboration capabilities from both coarse and fine perspectives.

answer_4.quote: we conducted experiments with 10 human participants performing tasks spanning all six levels.
answer_4.guideline: participants were instructed to complete their communication, reasoning, and action selection within a total duration of 10, 15, or 20 seconds per time step.
